text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President, here is the report on the 
sections requiring repair for the Holy 
Hoof Festival arch at the school gate. 
Please take a look.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will now distribute the food and 
beverage order forms to each booth. Please 
contact me on LANE if anything comes up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She works with the ferocity of a lion, 
doesn't she? 
Even with all the busy preparations for 
her own booth...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Worrying about the enemy? The "Emperor" 
must be feeling generous. Looking to show 
her some mercy?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I'll pass on such a lukewarm 
contest. 
Unless we tear into each other with 
everything we have, it's meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am well aware. 
Granting that desire was the condition for 
your participation in the booth, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More than anything... I have no intention 
of holding back either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since that vivid "Student Council 
Election"...—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
("A world where every horsegirl can find 
happiness." 
To realize my ideal, I had to begin by 
bringing happiness to the students of this 
academy.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Carrying that conviction in my heart, I 
took office as Student Council President— 
And in my first year, quite literally 
alone... I pressed forward along that 
solitary path.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(—The following year. An earth-shattering 
event occurred.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["I, Air Groove, hereby declare my 
candidacy for Student Council President!"]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["When I become President, I will embody 
the ideal of a competitor, giving hope to 
and guiding every horsegirl who yearns to 
run!"]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(—I was astonished. To think there was 
someone harboring such lofty ideals... 
someone who boldly proclaimed aspirations 
that others might easily mock as castles 
in the air.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["I am Symboli Rudolf, candidate for 
Student Council President. The manifesto I 
present is the completion of a training 
support system for all students."]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["From minor training concerns and 
questions to care for injuries and mental 
fatigue, my goal is a flawless system 
offering comprehensive support."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["I am Air Groove, candidate for Student 
Council President! 
My manifesto is 'Building an Approachable 
Organization.'"]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["First, we will develop an 'Opinion Box' 
app for students, creating a space where 
anyone can easily share their doubts and 
worries, or submit feedback and 
requests."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["I will watch over each and every 
student, listening to their voices and 
doing everything in my power to extend a 
helping hand!"]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["Quite a few students are undergoing 
rehabilitation, I see... 
—! Is that a rehabilitation machine?"]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["I introduced it last year. 
State-of-the-art equipment supervised by 
the foremost authority on horsegirl 
rehabilitation theory."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["...I see. In that case, the next step 
should be mental support. We need a 
framework to stand beside each student and 
resolve their personal worries and 
anxieties."]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Watching her throughout the campaign... I 
became certain that her conviction was 
genuine. I knew she possessed the strength 
to realize the ideals she spoke of. And 
so—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["Well, the ballot counting will begin 
shortly... but before that."]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["This election campaign was truly 
meaningful. 
It was an honor to compete against someone 
like you."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["...Indeed. Over this period, I too came 
to truly understand how deeply you wish 
for the happiness of horsegirls, and how 
tirelessly you have labored for it."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["Furthermore... it seems your ideals and 
mine share a common thread."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["I, too, am glad that my opponent was 
you."]

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
["Even so, I have no intention of losing. 
For the sake of my ideals, I shall claim 
the seat of President."]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(In the end, I won the election. 
However...— 
I was certain that her strength was 
indispensable to the student council.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["Air Groove. Will you accept the position 
of Vice President?"]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(She shares my vision—a person who would 
walk beside me in perfect harmony.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Just as my principles declare, I wish for 
the happiness of all. 
Yet, I also understand how daunting a path 
that is.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(That is precisely why my heart leaped. 
The more I listened to her during the 
election...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(I knew that with her, we could reach out 
to every single student and guide them 
toward a joyful future.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Someone who would chase those ideals with 
me... someone worthy of trusting with my 
back. 
I had gained an "unrivaled partner"————)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I trust and respect Air Groove as a 
comrade. 
Yet... that is precisely why this 
opportunity to compete against her once 
more fills me with such exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So there is no need to worry. 
I shall meet her with all my might—our 
beautiful "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of everything due today... 
It's gotten late.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Still, things are progressing well. The 
booth plans are coming together nicely... 
and Alve is showing real motivation now.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, it should turn out to be a 
magnificent concept cafe— 
...Wait—the gym lights are on... Someone 
is still in there...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Is that... the President and the 
others...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
["How pitiful, Black Knight King—nay, a 
mere phantom of history, 'Emperor' of a 
bygone era. Your reign reached its end 
long ago."]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["Do not flatter yourself, you arrogant 
monster." 
...And with that, I shall strike first to 
vanquish Brian.]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then, C.B.'s "Wandering Knight" enters the 
fray. A three-way battle unfolds over 
dominion of the continent... That is the 
premise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—This is the President's theatrical 
cafe...? 
I thought it would just be short skits 
performed between serving customers, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The theatrical play is the main 
attraction...? 
And the sheer level of polish is...――――)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A clash between Triple Tiara and Crown 
winners is the ultimate dream of any fan. 
If we deliver that fierce battle through 
theater, the audience will be enraptured.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I play the ancient "Black Knight King," 
rising once more upon learning of the 
continent's peril. 
I intend to captivate the fans completely 
with a darker performance unlike my usual 
self.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian, surely a "Monster's" fighting 
spirit amounts to more than that? 
Channel that raw ferocity befitting your 
title purely through instinct.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
C.B.'s "Wandering Knight" is the most 
elusive, free-spirited role in the play. 
Simply act as freely as you always do, and 
everyone will be spellbound by you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, from here begins our three-way 
stage combat. 
Even if it is merely a play, I fully 
intend to strike you both down for real—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["Lawless tyranny, the rule of a monster 
that hungers only for destruction... I can 
overlook it no longer. 
To vanquish thee, I have imbued my blade 
with magical might!"]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["Evil shall be conquered by evil, and I 
alone shall bring peace to the people! 
Therefore, I shall not leave their fate in 
the hands of a mere wanderer. Step aside, 
Wandering Knight!"]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
["I am the 'Emperor' who swallows even the 
darkness— 
By my blade, true sovereignty shall be 
demonstrated here and now!"]
